caption: The drawing depicts two clear glass bottles, each with a round, slightly flared neck and a flat base, shown side by side. Both bottles are rendered in shades of light blue and gray, with transparent effects to indicate the glass material. Each bottle features a white floral design on its front surface; the left bottle’s design has a central stem with several curved, leafy branches and a single large flower at the top, while the right bottle’s design is more simplified, with a central stem and branching, elongated leaves ending in small rounded buds. In the background, there are two rectangular boxes adjacent to the bottles: the box to the left of the left bottle and the box to the right of the right bottle. Each box contains a black-and-white line drawing corresponding to the floral design on the nearest bottle. The overall composition is set against a beige background, and the artist's signature "Gertrude Lemberg" appears below the right bottle.
title: Liquor Bottle
